After almost killing themselves in the fight, they realize the hallucination and get the treasure to the criminals, only to be threatened to be killed together with the villagers. Dhalsim paralyzes the two criminals and then heals Ryu and Ken's injuries, accepting to teach the boys the ways of Hadou.

Kugo and his ship disappear, and he is captured by the Fierce Bat in his underground lair. Hakka, disguised in a robot shell, goes to the rescue Kugo and destroys the robot control panel.
